name: jira-mcp-chat
description: MCP Chat Client for Jira with Next.js

scripts.dev: npm run install-all && cd chat-client && npm run dev
scripts.start: npm run install-all && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run install-all && npm run build-mcp && npm run build-client
scripts.install-all: npm run install-root && npm run install-mcp && npm run install-client
